#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail
source /etc/network_turbo
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

LOG="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion/eval_download.log"
MODELS="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/models"
RESULTS="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/results/exp005_zoo_expansion"
PATCH="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/scripts/patch_fla_eval.py"

echo "=== START $(date) ===" | tee "$LOG"

# --- Background: download DeltaNet pure + HGRN pure ---
(
  echo "BG: Downloading DeltaNet pure... $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  rm -rf "$MODELS/340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure"
  python3 -c "
import os; os.environ['HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET']='1'
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download('m-a-p/340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure', local_dir='$MODELS/340M-20B-DeltaNet-pure')
print('DeltaNet-pure download OK')
" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"

  echo "BG: Downloading HGRN pure... $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
  python3 -c "
import os; os.environ['HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET']='1'
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
try:
    snapshot_download('m-a-p/340M-20B-HGRN-pure', local_dir='$MODELS/340M-20B-HGRN-pure')
    print('HGRN-pure download OK')
except Exception as e:
    print(f'HGRN-pure failed: {e}, trying HGRN-pure-baseline...')
    snapshot_download('m-a-p/340M-20B-HGRN-pure-baseline', local_dir='$MODELS/340M-20B-HGRN-pure-baseline')
    print('HGRN-pure-baseline download OK')
" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
  echo "BG: All downloads done $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
) &
DL_PID=$!

# --- Foreground: eval HGRN h3-1 then GLA pure (serial GPU) ---

# Create eval wrapper that applies fla patch before lm_eval
cat > /tmp/eval_with_patch.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys, os
exec(open(os.environ.get("FLA_PATCH", "/root/entrainment_gated_ft/scripts/patch_fla_eval.py")).read())
from lm_eval.__main__ import cli_evaluate
cli_evaluate()
PYEOF

# Job 1: HGRN h3-1
HGRN_H31="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/models/340M-20B-HGRN-hybrid-3-1"
echo "EVAL HGRN h3-1 START $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
python3 /tmp/eval_with_patch.py \
  --model hf \
  --model_args pretrained=$HGRN_H31,trust_remote_code=True \
  --tasks lambada_openai,arc_easy \
  --device cuda:0 --batch_size auto --log_samples \
  --output_path "$RESULTS/HGRN_hybrid-3-1/" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "EVAL HGRN h3-1 DONE $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"

# Job 2: GLA pure
GLA_PURE="/root/entrainment_gated_ft/models/340M-20B-GLA-pure-baseline"
echo "EVAL GLA pure START $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
python3 /tmp/eval_with_patch.py \
  --model hf \
  --model_args pretrained=$GLA_PURE,trust_remote_code=True \
  --tasks lambada_openai,arc_easy \
  --device cuda:0 --batch_size auto --log_samples \
  --output_path "$RESULTS/GLA_pure/" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "EVAL GLA pure DONE $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"

# --- Wait for downloads, then eval newly downloaded models ---
echo "Waiting for background downloads... $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
wait $DL_PID
DL_EXIT=$?
echo "Downloads finished (exit=$DL_EXIT) $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"

# Eval DeltaNet pure
for suffix in "DeltaNet-pure" "DeltaNet-pure-baseline"; do
  PURE_DIR="$MODELS/340M-20B-${suffix}"
  if [ -f "$PURE_DIR/model.safetensors" ]; then
    SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$PURE_DIR/model.safetensors")
    if [ "$SIZE" -gt 100000000 ]; then
      echo "EVAL DeltaNet pure START ($PURE_DIR, ${SIZE}B) $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
      python3 /tmp/eval_with_patch.py \
        --model hf \
        --model_args pretrained=$PURE_DIR,trust_remote_code=True \
        --tasks lambada_openai,arc_easy \
        --device cuda:0 --batch_size auto --log_samples \
        --output_path "$RESULTS/DeltaNet_pure/" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
      echo "EVAL DeltaNet pure DONE $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
      break
    else
      echo "SKIP: $PURE_DIR model.safetensors too small (${SIZE}B)" | tee -a "$LOG"
    fi
  fi
done

# Eval HGRN pure
for suffix in "HGRN-pure" "HGRN-pure-baseline"; do
  PURE_DIR="$MODELS/340M-20B-${suffix}"
  if [ -f "$PURE_DIR/model.safetensors" ]; then
    SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$PURE_DIR/model.safetensors")

        --tasks lambada_openai,arc_easy \
        --device cuda:0 --batch_size auto --log_samples \
        --output_path "$RESULTS/HGRN_pure/" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
      echo "EVAL HGRN pure DONE $(date)" | tee -a "$LOG"
      break
    else
      echo "SKIP: $PURE_DIR model.safetensors too small (${SIZE}B)" | tee -a "$LOG"
    fi
  fi
done

echo "=== ALL COMPLETE $(date) ===" | tee -a "$LOG"
